description: 车消除控制e5的象，三步将杀
explanation_en: White removes the bishop controlling e5. After the pawn recaptures, the rook can check from e5 and drive the king into a mating net.

intro.popup: 💡 消除保护：黑象Bd4控制着e5格，阻止白车Re5+将军。如何消除这个障碍？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Remove the defender: Black's bishop on d4 controls e5 and prevents Re5+. How can White remove this obstacle?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxd4消除控制e5的象！exd4后Re5+迫使国王踏上g4，f3#将杀。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxd4 removes the bishop controlling e5. After exd4, Re5+ drives the king to g4, allowing f3#.

moves.popup: 车消除象！Bd4是守住e5格的关键防守子，牺牲换掉它！
moves.popup_en: The rook captures the bishop on d4. The bishop was the key defender of e5, so White gives up the rook to remove it.

moves.popup: 兵吃车，但e5格现已畅通无阻！
moves.popup_en: The pawn recaptures the rook, but the square e5 is now clear.

moves.popup: Re5+将军！象已消除，此着成立。国王只能去g4……
moves.popup_en: Re5+ gives check. With the bishop removed, this move is now possible and forces the king toward g4.

moves.popup: 国王被迫吃马，落入陷阱！
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to capture the knight and falls into the trap.
f3# is checkmate! The pawn delivers mate to the exposed king.
